whatShipped.item2_sharedReader: New artifacts/api-server/src/lib/buildableEnvelope/reconcileAtomEnvelope.ts reconciles the live-derived buildable envelope against the property atom chain's own buildableEnvelope.outcome, wired into brokeragePlaceBuildableEnvelope.ts right after deriveBuildableEnvelope(). The engine's atom never carries geometry (EnvelopeHonestOutcome is only {kind:'buildable', areaSqFt} or a decline reason -- confirmed in hauska-engine's atoms package), so derive.ts's live polygon stays the only drawable shape; reconciliation only ever corrects the reported area/outcome, never fabricates geometry. A validation-failed local decline is never overridden (a fact about our own geometry gates, not a measurement the atom's number could correct). Live-verified demonstrated defect this closes: parcel 48021:105032, atom said 9160 sq ft, the unreconciled route computed a different number.
whatShipped.item3_roadClassDefault: derive.ts no longer defaults to roadClassSetbackTableForJurisdiction() when a caller skips roadClassSetbackTable -- confirmed this was live and reachable (not just flagged) for real bastrop-city-tx P-5 parcels, since the real production caller always skipped it. Same defect class the engine side already refused via commit 293633a ('a road class is not a setback'). Explicit opt-in only now.
